tweets.text: .@Delta was great to me in MBS, but NOT great in DTW. I hope they make this right for @116470 & fix the attitudes w/ their DTW staff. DTW Gate agent was rude to me as well yesterday. https://t.co/rUf80TvLYp
@116471 @Delta Thx for the support @116471 - hopefully @delta will do the right thing for Jennifer & I in this frustrating episode & address DTW cust. service issues ....
@116470 I can authorize 5,000 bonus Skymiles be deposited into each of your SkyMiles accounts as a gesture for the inconvenience. (2/2) *TAC

@Delta Hi @Delta, thanks so much for your timely & sincere reply. This is part of the reason I remain a loyal #silvermedallion member. Your generous offer of 5K skymiles for both my wife & I is accepted & appreciated. Please reply or direct message me if you need contact details.

@116470 Hello, John. Our system shows you were already compensated for flight 4459 today with $100.00 Delta travel vouchers for each of you. Unfortunately, I cannot double compensate for the same flight. I am sorry to disappoint.  *TAC
@Delta Hi @Delta, I heard back over the phone after our correspondence earlier. I am happy with the accommodation & understand you cannot do both. Thank you and I appreciate your getting back to me.
@116470 You're most welcome. We are here for you 24/7. Tweet us anytime! *TAC
Dear @Delta Its been a pretty good run lately and I appreciate you for that. But the service Ive received the last two days not acceptable.
@116473 @Delta Despite your troubles getting here, welcome to MN!!
@116472 Mary, I am sorry to hear that. Thank you for taking the time and providing this feedback.  *AFM
